anchor: in not_judged, each with one sentence on why it is not the one tracked.
insert: When the outcome tracks a figure and also names the share of that same figure that one kind makes up, whether the supply that figure measures stays short of demand, or whether capacity keeps pace with the demand that figure measures, the two are one bet seen from two sides, not several things with none the main one: ask the figure, and list that second side in not_judged. A bank's total lending named with the share that is commercial lending is asked as the total lending; a retailer's holiday sales named with whether its shelves run short are asked as the sales; a utility's power demand named with whether its generating capacity keeps pace is asked as the demand.
